units.source_text: 此时玉鬘怕羞，把头转向一旁，其侧影非常美丽。

en.t: At this, Tamakazura grew shy and turned her head aside, and her profile was extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 她身穿红面蓝里的常礼服，内衬白面蓝里衫子，色彩配合十分调和，富有新颖艳丽之感。

en.t: She wore a formal robe with a red outer face and blue lining, over an inner garment white on the outside and blue within; the colors harmonized perfectly and gave a fresh, splendid impression.

units.source_text: 她的举止态度，本来未免还留着些乡下人习气，但也落落大方，处处富有优雅之趣；

en.t: Her manners and bearing had once inevitably retained a touch of rustic habit, yet she was open and graceful, with elegance showing everywhere;

units.source_text: 现在渐渐学会了京都人模样，更加端详可爱。

en.t: now she had gradually learned the ways of the capital and had become still more refined and charming.

units.source_text: 加之化妆十分讲究，所以毫无缺陷，只觉花容玉貌，艳丽无比。

en.t: Moreover, her makeup was exquisitely done, so there was not the slightest flaw; she seemed flower-faced and jewel-like, matchlessly radiant.

units.source_text: 源氏看了，心念将此人送与他人，实甚可惜。

en.t: Genji looked at her and thought it would be a great pity to give such a person to someone else.

units.source_text: 右近带笑看着这两个人，心中也在想：“源氏主君年纪很轻，不配做她父亲，还不如双双配合，倒是一对天生佳偶。”

en.t: Ukon watched the two of them with a smile and thought to herself, “Lord Genji is still young and hardly suited to be her father; it would be better if the two were joined, for they would make a naturally perfect pair.”

units.source_text: 便对源氏说：“我从来不曾把别人来信传送给小姐。

en.t: She then said to Genji, “I have never passed letters from other men on to the young lady.

units.source_text: 大人以前看过的三四封信，我深恐使对方受辱，未便立即退回，所以暂时把信收下。

en.t: As for the three or four letters Your Lordship saw before, I feared deeply that returning them at once would humiliate the senders, so I accepted them for the time being.

units.source_text: 至于复信，必须等候大人吩咐后再说。

en.t: As for any reply, I must wait for Your Lordship’s instructions before doing anything.

units.source_text: 如此对付，小姐还嫌麻烦呢。”

en.t: Even handled in this way, the young lady still finds it troublesome.”

units.source_text: 源氏问她：“那封摺叠得很精致的信，是谁寄来的？

en.t: Genji asked her, “Who sent that letter folded so elegantly?

units.source_text: 笔迹非常秀丽呢。”

en.t: The handwriting is very graceful.”

units.source_text: 他带笑看着那封信。

en.t: He looked at the letter with a smile.

units.source_text: 右近答道：“这封信么，那送信人不问我们受与不受，放着管自走了。

en.t: Ukon replied, “This letter? The messenger did not ask whether we would accept it or not, but simply left it here and went away.

units.source_text: 这是内大臣家大公子柏木中将写来的，他和这里的小侍女见子以前就相识，是交她收转的。

en.t: It was written by Lieutenant General Kashiwagi, the eldest son of the Minister of the Interior’s household; he has known the little maid Miko here for some time, and entrusted it to her to pass on.

units.source_text: 除了见子以外，这里并无帮他忙的人。”

en.t: Apart from Miko, there is no one here to help him.”

units.source_text: 源氏说：“这倒很有意思了。

en.t: Genji said, “That is quite interesting.

units.source_text: 他的官位虽然不高，但对这种人你们岂可怠慢？

en.t: Although his rank is not high, how could you treat such a man carelessly?

units.source_text: 公卿们官位虽高，但有许多人声望未必能与柏木并比。

en.t: Many courtiers may hold higher office, but in reputation they cannot necessarily compare with Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 在诸公子中，这位大公子也最为稳重。

en.t: Among all the young gentlemen, this eldest son is also the most steady and dignified.

units.source_text: 他和小姐是兄妹，这实情他将来自有知道的一天。

en.t: He and the young lady are brother and sister, and one day he will naturally come to know the truth.

units.source_text: 目前你们暂勿揭穿，姑且敷衍他一下吧。

en.t: For now, do not reveal it; just deal with him tactfully for the time being.

units.source_text: 这封信写得真漂亮。”

en.t: This letter is truly beautifully written.”

units.source_text: 他拿着信，一时不忍释手。

en.t: He held the letter and for a while could not bear to put it down.

units.source_text: 又对玉鬘说：“我这般那般地对你说，不知你心作何感想，我很挂念。

en.t: Then he said to Tamakazura, “I worry because I do not know what you think in your heart when I speak to you about this and that.

units.source_text: 即使要告知内大臣，亦必须考虑：你现在态度如此稚气，身份尚未有定，立刻参与素不相识的诸异母兄弟姐妹之列，是否妥便？

en.t: Even if we are to tell the Minister of the Interior, we must consider whether it is proper for you, still so childish in manner and with your status not yet settled, to be placed at once among half brothers and sisters you have never known.

units.source_text: 还不如先有了丈夫，决定了身份，然后自有父女相见的机会。

en.t: It would be better first to have a husband and establish your position; afterward, an opportunity for father and daughter to meet will come naturally.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王虽是独身之人，然而秉性浮薄，结识情妇甚多，家中还有不少名声不佳的婢妾。

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo may be unmarried, but he is frivolous by nature, has many mistresses, and there are also quite a few women of poor reputation in his household.

units.source_text: 若要做他的夫人，除非其人宽大为怀，心无憎恨，方可安然无事。

en.t: If one were to become his wife, only a woman broad-minded and free of resentment could remain at peace.

units.source_text: 如果其人略有嫉妒之心，则反目失欢之事，自然难于避免，此点必须顾虑。

en.t: If she had even a little jealousy in her heart, estrangement and discord would naturally be hard to avoid, and this must be taken into account.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将呢，讨厌他那个长年相处的夫人年纪太大，正在多方物色少女。

en.t: As for General Higekuro, he dislikes the fact that the wife who has lived with him for many years is too old, and he is now searching in every direction for a young girl.

units.source_text: 然而这也是世间女子所不乐就的。

en.t: Yet this too is something women in the world are not happy to accept.

units.source_text: 此乃当然之事，所以我也独自在心中左顾右虑，苦无定见。

en.t: That is only natural, and so I too turn the matter over alone in my heart, unable to settle on a decision.

units.source_text: 关于姻缘之事，即使在父母面前，也难于分明说出自己的愿望。

en.t: When it comes to marriage, even before one’s parents it is hard to state one’s own wishes clearly.

units.source_text: 但你现在已非童稚之年，应该对万事都能自己辨别是非了。

en.t: But you are no longer a child, and you should now be able to judge right and wrong for yourself in all matters.

units.source_text: 你可把我看作昔年逝世的母亲，有事和我商量。

en.t: You may think of me as the mother who died long ago, and consult me whenever anything arises.

units.source_text: 凡是不能使你称心的事，我都舍不得做。”

en.t: Anything that would not please your heart is something I cannot bear to do.”
